about: The one power scale (powers wave 1, docs/design/powers.md). A being's strength is its LEVEL, 1 to 100: level = perTen x log10(might / base), so every ten levels is ten times the might. Might is a single number: for a person, his fighting worth in conscripts (A.V2S.shownConscripts, the number his sheet shows) squared, which is the Lanchester fighting strength of the band of conscripts he equals; for a beast, the same from its duel worth and blood (the human fit below), or the bestiary's level. The level alone does not settle a fight: each being also has a profile of capabilities, and titles add to both.

people.about: ln(conscripts) = lnA + lnB x worth, fitted on 656 humans of seed 7 at the start (A.fightWorth against A.V2S.shownConscripts); used to put the release's beasts on the people's scale: conscripts x sqrt(blood / 100), squared

odds.about: the chance that A beats B: 1 / (1 + (mightB / mightA)^k) on the might after the profile's matchup. k = 0.55: one of the release's fighter tiers (about 14 worth, one e-fold of conscripts, e squared of might) wins three fights in four. A fight is settled without the duel engine when the gap passes hugeGap levels.

bands.d: Rats, crows, a stray cur. A nuisance, deadly only to the sick or the very young.
A fox, a hedge cat, most people who never held a weapon in earnest.
A drilled soldier, a hill wolf, a wild boar. One against one, either can die.
A veteran, a bear, a pack of wolves together. A village loses men to it.
A knight of an order, a great cat, a troll. A lord sends hunters with spears and dogs.
The best fighters of a realm, the human masters, an ordinary grown giant, a great bear or a young dragon. A hall of heroes in songs.
The masters of the elder and great races, great dragons, wyrms, the great beasts of the old lore. A champion of men dies here alone.
Elder dragons, the giant kings, the great spirits. Only a host can stand against one.
Ancient dragons, the eldest giants, sea monsters that sink fleets. Kingdoms make their peace with them.
A being the chronicles name an age after. Hosts break on it.
The oldest powers: the sea's mother, the first fire. The world itself moves around them.

capabilities.d: weight, reach and the force of a blow
whether you can outrun it, and whether it can outrun you
how much of a blade it shrugs off; a light weapon barely bites
a scratch that kills a day later; a hardy body and a healer help
it chooses when to fight; only a bow or a spear thrown reaches it
wounds close as you make them; only fire, a long fight won or a killing blow ends it
charms, prayers and spells slide off it
it comes as many: one fighter is surrounded; a shield wall holds
it ambushes, finds you hiding and learns your tricks
breath, fire, frost, glamour or spells: the reach of a weapon means little

intelligence.d: Acts by instinct: hunger, the season, its ground. It hunts, flees and guards, and holds no grudge.
Plans an ambush and remembers a trap, but cannot bargain or reason with you.
Speaks, bargains, lies and holds a grudge. Its choices have reasons, and it can be talked to.
Old and deep: it plans for years, keeps its word or its hatred for generations, and weighs kingdoms.

masters.d: The eldest giant still on a throne. Three hundred years of war in his arms and shoulders.
Two centuries at the forge and the gate. Rune-steel on his back that no smith of men can scratch.
Four hundred years with one sword. She has outlived every school that tried to teach men her way.
Took his seat over the bodies of forty challengers. No man of the west has lasted a minute with him.
